job.emphasis: start and grow your online store

scenes.brief: Show Shopify wordmark and tagline with brand colors.
Show the Shopify homepage featuring the storefront builder.
Show the Sidekick AI assistant interface on the Shopify dashboard.
From the homepage, navigate to and demonstrate start and grow your online store, showing 2-3 distinct steps.
Display call-to-action for free trial with Shopify URL.

beats.text: Shopify lets you launch a store that customers line up for.
Build your brand fast with AI-powered tools that get you selling quickly today.
Meet Sidekick, your AI assistant that automates tasks, boosts sales, and helps you grow.
Start by choosing a template, then let Sidekick generate product descriptions, set up payments, and launch your store in minutes flat.
Start your free trial at shopify.com and begin building today.
